components.text: The current operation set covers projectiles, elements, motion, emission, triggers, and persistence. @RegisteredOp discovery places definitions into OpDefinitionRegistry

pages.text: • ElementOp / ElementConversionOp / ElementVolumeOp: absorb, convert, and affect element concentrations.
• FireProjectileOp / WaterProjectileOp / ManaProjectileOp / IlluminationOp: create projectile or illumination entities.
• MomentumOp / SplitEmitOp / ProjectionOp: calculate motion, split emission, and canvas projection.

• ExplosionOp / SmeltOp / BrewingOp / CarryItemsOp: affect blocks, items, and brewing flows.
• FollowingOp / RotationOp / LoopOp: follow, rotate, and repeat tick behavior.
• TriggerOp / WaterBurstOp / OnDiscardOp / RemoveOnHitOp: events, collisions, and cleanup callbacks.
